label: A skill is a directory holding SKILL.md with Agent Skills frontmatter: name, description, license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools, user-invocable and disable-model-invocation.

Skill discovery order is skill_paths, then project .vibe/skills and .agents/skills, then user skills dirs, then plugin skills, then registry skills; the first claimant of a name wins and later ones are shadowed.
user-invocable defaults true and is the switch that exposes a skill as a slash command; false makes it model-only and hides it from the slash menu.
enabled_skills and disabled_skills are glob-or-regex filters and enabled_skills wins outright when set, so a closed skill roster is expressible.

A subagent is an agent profile with agent_type subagent invoked through the task tool, whose agent argument defaults to explore and is gated by an allowlist defaulting to explore plus a glob denylist.

Subagent concurrency is config-bounded: enable_subagents defaults true, max_subagents is 32 alive and max_concurrent_subagents is 32 running turns, and a spawn past either bound fails until a slot frees.
enabled_agents is a glob-or-regex allowlist over agent names and installed_agents records opt-in builtins, so an agent roster is expressible the same way as a skill roster.

Repo mapping: .skilled/skills becomes a .vibe/skills symlink farm, .skilled/commands becomes skills because no command-file format exists, and .opencode/agents becomes .vibe/agents TOML with agent_type subagent where appropriate.

reason: No such directory is read by discovery and the slash-command registry is a closed builtin set plus skills.
